name: spicy-lyrics
description: Word-level community lyric syncs from the Spicy Lyrics API. Needs only a free Spicy Lyrics key; Spotify credentials are optional.
author: Community

settings.label: Spicy Lyrics API key
settings.description: Paste your application's publishable key (sl_pk_...). On developers.spicylyrics.org: Dashboard > Applications > your app > turn on client access, add 'No origin header', then copy the sl_pk_ key. A secret key (sl_sk_) is only for servers.

settings.label: Show background vocals as separate lines
settings.description: Shows backing vocals as a small line under the main lyric. Turn off to hide them.

settings.label: Timing offset (ms)
settings.description: Shift all lyric timing. Negative = earlier (e.g. -300 if lyrics show late), positive = later. Default 0.

settings.label: Word-by-word timing
settings.description: On: words highlight one by one. Off: whole-line sync only. Turn off to check whether a sync problem comes from word timing.

settings.label: Alternate sides for duets
settings.description: When a song has more than one singer, show the second singer's lines on the right.

settings.label: Spotify Client ID (optional)
settings.description: Optional. Only needed if you want Spotify search instead of the built-in key-free lookup.

settings.label: Accept unsynced lyrics
settings.description: If Spicy Lyrics only has plain text for a track, return it instead of skipping.

settings.label: Reset Spotify token cache
settings.description: Use after changing the Spotify credentials.

settings.label: Test connection
settings.description: Looks up a test track's Spotify ID and checks your Spicy Lyrics key, and tells you which step fails.

settings.label: Test track (Title - Artist)
settings.description: Optional. Used by Test connection instead of the built-in example, e.g. Tylenol - Jaydes.

settings.label: Show last lookup
settings.description: Shows what happened the last time the app asked this extension for lyrics.
